name: Main Process, Renderer, Worker, and Sidecar Boundaries
description: Define the contract between Electron main process, renderer, web workers, and native sidecars. IPC schema, lifecycle ownership, and error propagation.
purpose: Process boundaries are enforced, not advisory.
acceptanceCriteria: IPC schema is versioned and validated on every message
Main process owns all system resources and brokers access to renderers
Renderer crash does not leak resources or corrupt main process state
Web workers have defined input/output contracts and cancellation semantics
Native sidecars are lifecycle-managed: spawn, health-check, graceful shutdown, force-kill
Error propagation follows defined escalation path: worker → renderer → main → user
Process restart is scoped — a renderer restart does not restart the main process
required_evidence: IPC schema version validation on every message test
Renderer crash isolation test (no resource leakage to main process)
Sidecar lifecycle test (spawn → health → shutdown → force-kill)
Error propagation test (worker → renderer → main → user)
Scoped restart test (renderer restart does not restart main)
acceptance_gates: IPC schema is versioned and validated
Renderer crash does not leak resources or corrupt main
Error propagation follows defined escalation path
rollback_strategy: Process spawn failure rolls back via resource registry teardown of child processes
recovery_strategy: Scoped restart of failed process; escalation to user if scoped restart fails
escalation_policy: If a process cannot be restarted after max attempts, escalate to user with failure report
